publication_name: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CU database)
access_description: Documented CU flat files cu.series and cu.data.1.AllItems. The CPI Atom feed is a different dataset and is not this access path.
conditions: Cite the retrieval date and state that BLS.gov cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived after retrieval. Do not modify figures and still present them as unaltered BLS content. Do not use the BLS logo.
revision_behaviour: The cu.data.1.AllItems file holds one current value for each month. It does not carry historical vintages, so stored rows are latest revised with unknown availability. A preliminary mark or a footnote, including footnote R (revised), remains the current observed value when a number is present. It is not recorded as an earlier provider vintage. A blank, a dash, a zero, or another non-numeric value is omitted. Footnote X marks data unavailable, as in October 2025, and that month is omitted. Omitted periods are not stored as zero and are not interpolated.
unresolved_questions: The BLS terms do not name AI processing or model training, so those operations stay unknown. A download of the current file cannot reconstruct vintages from before Aqil collects them.
evidence_note: cu.series on 22 October 2026 identifies CUSR0000SA0 as seasonal code S (seasonally adjusted), periodicity code R (monthly), item SA0, area 0000, and base period 1982-84=100, titled all items in the U.S. city average, all urban consumers, seasonally adjusted. The same BLS terms cited for bls_cps_unemployment_rate cover this flat file. Sahm requires bls.ln.LNS14000000, SLOOS requires fed.sloos.SUBLPDCILS_N.Q, Census advance orders requires census.m3.adv.MDM.NO, MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL requires those three dataset ids, and PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE requires bls.ln.LNS14000000. None of them consume bls.cu.CUSR0000SA0. Assessed 2026-10-22.
